learning_outcomes.text: Determine the tax treatment of business entities (sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations, S corporations and farmers)
Compute business income, deductions, basis, depreciation and the QBI deduction
Analyze business financial records to prepare accurate returns
Handle specialized business returns, trusts, exempt organizations and retirement plans

integrative_case: A two-owner LLC that recently elected S-corporation status asks an Enrolled Agent to allocate income, compute reasonable compensation, depreciate new equipment and determine each owner's stock and debt basis for the year.
